en.name: Semolina (sooji)
en.summary: Semolina is coarsely milled durum wheat with the germ largely removed, so it keeps like white flour rather than like a whole grain: about 6–8 months in an airtight container in a cool cupboard, or about 1 year refrigerated. Wholemeal rava, which keeps its germ, is a different and shorter-lived thing.
en.pantry: An airtight container in a cool cupboard gives about 6–8 months. Because semolina is milled from the endosperm with the germ largely taken out, rancidity is rarely what ends it — insects or a musty smell from damp are the usual reasons a jar gets thrown out. Dry-roasting a batch in a pan and cooling it completely before storing is a common Indian household step and does genuinely buy time, as well as making better upma. If your rava is wholemeal or unrefined and still carries the germ, treat it like a wholemeal flour and use it much sooner.
en.fridge: A sealed container in the fridge gives about 1 year. Seal it properly against both odours and moisture — semolina picks up smells easily — and bring it back to room temperature before opening so condensation does not clump it. That is the main risk with fridge storage of any flour: a cold jar opened in a warm kitchen wets the surface of the contents, and clumped semolina is on its way to mould rather than simply being inconvenient.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for semolina here. Refined flours do freeze, and a sealed container in the freezer deals with pantry moths in a bulk purchase, but no figure is published for it and this page will not invent one — the refrigerated year is already long enough for any realistic household stock. Let a frozen container warm to room temperature before opening, for the same condensation reason as above.
spoilage: Webbing, larvae, small moths or fine dust — the commonest reason to discard semolina.
A musty or damp smell, or clumps that will not break up.
A bitter or paint-like smell, which points to a wholemeal rava whose germ oil has turned.
Visible mould anywhere in the container.
tips: Dry-roast and cool a batch before storing; it keeps better and cooks better.
Check for webbing before using semolina that has sat a while.
Keep it away from spices and soap; it absorbs smells quickly.
Store wholemeal rava separately and use it sooner.

faq.a: About 6–8 months in an airtight container in a cool cupboard, or about 1 year refrigerated.

faq.q: Should sooji be roasted before storing?
faq.a: It is a common practice and it does help — dry-roast it, cool it completely, then seal it. It also improves the texture of upma.

faq.q: Does wholemeal rava keep as long?
faq.a: No. It still carries the germ and its oil, so treat it like a wholemeal flour and use it much sooner.

zh.name: 粗粒小麥粉
zh.summary: 粗粒小麥粉是杜蘭小麥粗磨、並大致去除胚芽的產品，所以它的保存方式接近白麵粉而不是全穀：密封放陰涼櫥櫃約 6～8 個月，冷藏約 1 年。保留胚芽的全麥 rava 則是另一回事，短命得多。
zh.pantry: 密封容器放陰涼的櫥櫃約 6～8 個月。因為它是從胚乳磨出來、胚芽大致被去掉的，所以很少因為走油耗而結束——一罐被丟掉的原因，通常是生蟲或受潮後的霉味。先乾鍋炒過、完全放涼再收起來，是印度家庭常見的一步，確實能爭取時間，做出來的 upma 也更好吃。如果你的 rava 是全麥或未精製、還帶著胚芽，那就當全麥麵粉看待，要早得多用完。
zh.fridge: 密封容器放冰箱約 1 年。密封要同時防氣味和防潮——粗粒小麥粉很會吸味——而且開封前先回到室溫，免得結露結塊。這也是所有麵粉冷藏保存最主要的風險：冰冷的罐子在溫暖廚房打開，內容物表面就會被打濕，而結塊的粗粒小麥粉不只是不好用，它已經在往發霉的路上走。
zh.freezer: 這裡沒有給粗粒小麥粉的冷凍期限。精製粉類確實可以冷凍，密封容器放冷凍也能解決大量採購時的穀蛾，但沒有公布的數字，本頁不會憑空生一個——冷藏那一年，對任何實際的家庭庫存來說已經夠長了。從冷凍取出的容器同樣要先回到室溫再開，理由和上面一樣。
spoilage: 出現絲網、幼蟲、小蛾或細粉屑——這是最常丟掉它的原因。
有潮霉味，或結成撥不開的塊。
聞到苦味或油漆味，通常代表那是全麥 rava、胚芽油脂已經變質。
容器內任何位置看得到霉。
tips: 先乾鍋炒過並完全放涼再收——耐放，也更好煮。
放了一陣子的粉，使用前先檢查有沒有絲網。
遠離香料和肥皂；它吸味非常快。
全麥 rava 另外存放，而且要更早用完。

faq.q: 粗粒小麥粉可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封容器放陰涼櫥櫃約 6～8 個月，或冷藏約 1 年。

faq.q: sooji 收起來之前要先炒過嗎？
faq.a: 這是常見做法，也確實有幫助——乾鍋炒過、完全放涼再密封。做 upma 的口感也會更好。

faq.q: 全麥 rava 一樣耐放嗎？
faq.a: 不一樣。它還帶著胚芽和油脂，請當全麥麵粉看待，要早得多用完。
